title: Trump reduces military exercises with South Korea, citing good ties with Kim Jong Un
description: The president cited the cost of the drills and said he did not want to send a signal that is "totally inappropriate and hostile" to North Korea. He also criticized South Korea for not helping him on Iran.

title: Navy weighs major warship redesign to match Trump’s preferences
description: The president wants the new fleet of aircraft carriers to more resemble those from World War II. Such a change could cost billions.

title: Trump says White House needs ‘military complex’ as courts block his ballroom
description: When Trump first unveiled his plans for the new East Wing addition, he said it was needed to host VIP guests. More recently, he is calling it a “desperately needed National Security structure.”

title: Blanche on whether DOJ will be independent: ‘I’m not going to pledge that’
description: The newly sworn-in attorney general rejected the idea of an independent Justice Department, lent support to Jeanine Pirro and declared the “anti-weaponization” fund dead.

title: Angry at the Supreme Court, liberals push a slew of plans for overhauling it
description: As the midterms near, Democrats are proposing adding more justices, limiting their terms and more.

title: Senate hopeful Talarico touts his faith. Texas Republicans call it blasphemy.
description: The Democratic nominee is seeking to win over faith-based voters in Texas, the Bible Belt’s largest state, but evangelical Republicans aren’t sold.

title: 'What are we going to do?' The mom of a trans teen grapples with Trump's Medicaid move
description: A longtime Republican living in California says the Trump administration's continuing actions to target transgender youth take a personal toll.

title: In Florida, Congressman Byron Donalds' seat is up for grabs for Republicans
description: In southwest Florida, ten Republicans are vying for the nomination to replace Rep. Byron Donalds. With the majority of candidates from outside the state - it's raising questions about representation.

title: Polls everywhere in primary season. Can they be trusted?
description: How reliable are political polls right now? NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben speaks to G. Elliott Morris from the data-driven news website, Strength In Numbers.

title: Politics chat: Democrats take lessons from the primaries, set 2028 calendar
description: We look at how the Democrats are gearing up for the 2028 presidential primaries, as well as their takeaways from the current batch of primary races.

title: Democrats approve 2028 primary calendar that puts South Carolina first
description: South Carolina would hold its primary on Jan. 22, 2028 under the Democratic National Committee’s plan. Nevada would follow on Feb. 1. The plan aims to give a bigger voice to Black and Latino voters.

title: State Department spokesperson on Iran war and U.S. visa revocations
description: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott about the with Iran and the hundreds of thousands of foreign nationals who have had their U.S. visa revoked.

title: Families of USS Lincoln crew say Trump should be 'ashamed' of conditions on board
description: President Trump said the USS Abraham Lincoln deployment is "not nearly long enough." A family member of a sailor on board that ship said those comments are shameful.

title: Democrats abandon Senate races in deep-red states, boosting independents
description: Democratic Senate nominees in Nebraska, Idaho and South Dakota dropped out, clearing the way for independents. But Alani Bankhead in Montana declined to join them.

title: Killings and other violent crimes dropped sharply in 2025
description: The White House is seizing on new statistics showing that violent crime plummeted last year to boast of a “Trump effect.” But experts note crime began falling well before Trump returned to office.

title: Week in Politics: USS Lincoln; latest primaries and Democrats; White House ballroom
description: A shortage of some munitions as well as the problems with the USS Lincoln have the Trump administration on the defensive. Meanwhile, what the latest primaries show about Democratic enthusiasm.

title: They fought for the U.S. in Afghanistan. Now they worry about losing their green cards
description: When the U.S. withdrew from Afghanistan five years ago, thousands of Afghans who helped U.S. troops were brought here to rebuild their lives. But now, some fear the U.S. may want to send them back.

title: Democrats grapple with Trump's push to limit transparency within the executive branch
description: President Trump is pushing the boundaries of executive power to limit transparency within the executive branch. Congressional Democrats are grappling with how to respond.

title: U.S. missionary who was kidnapped in Niger is released
description: Kevin Rideout "is in good health in the care of US officials," SIM International said in a statement, adding he would soon be reunited with his family.
